title: Pure Fishborg
summary: Fishborg cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Fishborgs are WATER Fish Tuners that come back from the GY to keep Synchro Summoning; the page runs them as an engine inside WATER decks like Ghoti. Fishborg Harpooner, the newest card (2024), reveals itself with another WATER monster in the hand, summons one and discards the other. Used for a WATER Synchro, it negates a monster. Fishborg Launcher revives itself while every monster in your GY is WATER. Fishborg Archer revives itself onto an empty field by discarding a WATER monster. Fishborg Planter mills the top card and revives itself if it was WATER. The hand traps aren't WATER, so they cost Launcher's revival once they reach the GY. Fishborg Blaster is Forbidden.
main: Newest Level 4 Tuner: summons itself or another WATER; negates as WATER Synchro material.
Level 1 Tuner: revives itself while your GY is all WATER.
Level 3 Tuner: revives itself onto an empty field by discarding a WATER.

extra: Level 10 Synchro: Quick Effect Synchro Summoned on opponent's turn to immediately banish all cards on the field.
Level 8 Synchro: targets and banishes 1 Fish you control and 1 card the opponent controls on summon, and revives itself from GY.
